python_version.description: Exact Python major.minor or major.minor.patch requested by upstream.

requirements.description: Package requirements already selected upstream. They are installation requests, not actual environment identity.

dependency_install_timeout_seconds.description: Optional hard timeout for the single dependency installation command. Defaults to 240 seconds when omitted.

find_links.description: Optional HTTPS wheel/archive indexes passed to pip --find-links.

verify_imports.description: Critical Python modules that must import successfully in the completed environment.

executable.description: Executable path relative to the completed environment directory.

argv.description: Parameterised arguments for the upstream-defined readiness target; never interpreted as shell text.

working_directory.description: Working directory relative to the runtime-authorized workspace.

timeout_seconds.description: Hard timeout for the low-cost readiness probe.

runtime_readiness_probe.description: Optional upstream-defined real program probe that must pass before this environment is recorded as runtime-ready.
